title: Identity Orchestration Glossary | Routing, fallback and eID-native architecture
summary: Plain-language definitions of identity orchestration, dynamic routing, fallback, method coverage and eID-native architecture.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: August 10, 2026*


*The vocabulary of multi-method identity verification, made simple.*


This glossary defines six concepts behind multi-method identity verification: identity orchestration, the orchestration layer, dynamic routing, identity fallback, method coverage, and eID-native architecture.


Each entry starts with a plain-language definition and adds the practical detail underneath.


For the regulatory vocabulary of eIDAS 2.0 and the EUDI Wallet, see the[EUDI & eIDAS 2.0 glossary pt. 1](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt1) .
